site.name: lattice
site.summary: lattice-clone Fictional hosted columnar / relational database "Lattice DB" marketing site, centered on the two-dimensional matrix on the pricing page. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Short landing: technical paragraph + SQL code example + 3 features + CTA | | `pricing.html` | Main page: 6 rows (seats) × 6 columns (data volume) two-dimensional matrix; clicking a cell highlights the row and column and updates the right-side sticky quote card (with a "How this is calculated" expansion); 9 add-on checkboxes (percentage or flat add-on); bottom final monthly-fee breakdown card; 4-tier explainer (clicking a cell auto-highlights the corresponding tier); 15-row feature comparison; 8-question FAQ; footer | | `styles.css` | Brand color #6D28D9 purple; IBM Plex Sans + Mono; responsive |

run_plan.goal: Exhaustively explore the Lattice DB marketing site with emphasis on the pricing decision flow: moving from the landing page to the pricing matrix, selecting pricing cells, applying add-ons, reviewing the quote breakdown, and validating adjacent explanatory content and responsive behavior.
run_plan.summary: Start on the short landing page to confirm the entry path into pricing and sanity-check the top navigation and CTA behavior. Spend most of the run on pricing.html, since the prescan shows the core interactive system there: a 6x6 pricing matrix, sticky quote card, expandable calculation details, 9 add-on checkboxes, tier explainer mapping, feature matrix, FAQ, and footer links. Use desktop first for full-state coverage, then repeat the most important pricing interactions on mobile because the prescan already flagged several small tap targets in the header.
assumptions: The primary user journey is index.html -> pricing.html via the visible Pricing nav link or See pricing CTA.
The pricing matrix cells are intended to be interactive even though the prescan labeled them as table cells rather than buttons.
The right-side quote card updates based on selected matrix cell and may also change when add-ons are toggled.
The 'How this is calculated' area is an expandable disclosure on pricing.html.
Docs, Customers, Sign in, and Book demo appear to use '#' links in the prescan and should be validated as placeholder or non-navigating controls rather than assumed full destinations.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html pricing matrix: 6x6 cell selection, especially row/column highlight synchronization and selected-state clarity
pricing.html sticky quote card: price, selected cell label, and tier label staying in sync after repeated cell changes
pricing.html 'How this is calculated' expansion: disclosure behavior, readability, and collapse/expand consistency
pricing.html 9 add-on checkboxes: mixed percentage and flat-fee logic, cumulative updates, and breakdown accuracy
pricing.html bottom final monthly-fee breakdown card: reflects current base selection and add-on state without stale values
pricing.html 4-tier explainer: clicking a matrix cell auto-highlights the corresponding tier; verify mapping for multiple seat/data combinations
pricing.html matrix 'Contact us' cells and 301+ seats row: special-case behavior and recovery when no numeric monthly quote is available
pricing.html feature matrix and FAQ: scan for truncation, alignment, and disclosure usability if interactive
site-wide header links on mobile: multiple prescan small tap target warnings on nav items

phases.title: Landing page entry and navigation sanity check
phases.objective: Validate that the landing page clearly funnels users into the pricing experience and that visible top-level links behave as expected.
key_checks: Load index.html and confirm core content hierarchy: hero statement, SQL example, three feature cards, and See pricing CTA
Click See pricing and confirm it reaches pricing.html
Check header links Lattice DB, Platform, and Pricing for sensible navigation between known pages
Probe Docs, Customers, Sign in, and Book demo once each to verify whether they are placeholders, inert anchors, or cause unexpected jumps
Assess whether the landing page gives enough pricing context before the CTA
exit_criteria: Confirmed at least one clean path from index.html into pricing.html
Header/navigation behavior documented for all visible landing-page links
No ambiguity remains about which control launches the primary pricing flow

phases.title: Core pricing matrix behavior
phases.objective: Exercise the main pricing interaction model and verify that selected states, highlights, and quote-card updates are coherent across representative cells.
key_checks: Identify default selection state on initial load, if any
Click representative matrix cells across the grid: at least one low-end numeric cell, one mid-range numeric cell, one high numeric cell, and one or more 'Contact us' cells
Verify each click highlights the correct row and column intersection and updates the selected price in the sticky quote card
Verify the selected seat band and data-volume context remain understandable after multiple changes
Check whether the sticky quote card stays visible and usable during scrolling
Use repeated back-to-back cell changes to look for stale highlights, stale price text, or mismatched tier labels
exit_criteria: Representative coverage achieved across numeric and Contact us matrix states
Quote-card synchronization confirmed or clearly broken for multiple selections
Row/column highlighting behavior observed for several distinct cells

phases.title: Quote calculation and add-on composition
phases.objective: Validate the pricing explanation and additive cost controls that turn a base cell into a fuller monthly quote.
key_checks: Open and close the 'How this is calculated' disclosure and verify the content is understandable and visually stable
Toggle several add-ons individually to confirm each visibly affects the quote or breakdown where applicable
Test both percentage-style add-ons and flat-fee add-ons, since the prescan mentions both types
Select multiple add-ons together and verify cumulative behavior in the final monthly-fee breakdown card
Turn add-ons back off to confirm totals recover correctly without lingering charges
Check whether add-on interactions behave differently for numeric cells versus Contact us cells
exit_criteria: At least one percentage add-on and one flat-fee add-on validated
Multi-add-on state and recovery state both observed
Final monthly-fee breakdown behavior documented for at least one numeric quote and one special-case quote if supported

phases.title: Explanatory and supporting pricing content
phases.objective: Confirm that supporting sections reinforce the matrix selection rather than confusing or breaking the flow.
key_checks: Verify clicking matrix cells auto-highlights the corresponding tier in the 4-tier explainer
If the tier explainer itself is interactive, test whether clicking tier cells changes or clarifies state without conflicting with the matrix
Scroll through the 15-row feature matrix to check readability, alignment, and whether the current tier context remains understandable
Review the 8-question FAQ for expansion behavior if interactive, or at minimum for scannability and answer visibility
Check footer content and links for obvious dead ends or unexpected behavior
exit_criteria: Tier-mapping behavior confirmed for multiple matrix selections
Feature matrix and FAQ reviewed for layout and comprehension issues
Lower-page content covered enough to assess whether it supports the pricing decision

phases.title: Mobile pass on critical flows
phases.objective: Repeat the most important pricing interactions on a mobile viewport, focusing on tapability, responsive layout, and sticky/scroll behavior.
key_checks: Revisit header controls on mobile and test the nav links that were flagged as small tap targets in the prescan
Confirm the landing-page CTA remains prominent and easy to activate on mobile
On pricing.html, verify the matrix remains understandable and operable on a small viewport, including horizontal scrolling or stacking if present
Repeat a small set of critical matrix selections on mobile: one numeric cell, one higher-end cell, and one Contact us cell
Toggle at least two add-ons on mobile and confirm the quote/breakdown remains visible and comprehensible
Check whether the sticky quote card, disclosure, FAQ, and long-table sections behave acceptably while scrolling
exit_criteria: Primary landing-to-pricing flow completed on mobile
Critical pricing interactions repeated successfully or major mobile blockers identified
Small-tap-target impact assessed on the header and key actions

coverage_targets.pages: Visit both known HTML pages, with light coverage on index.html and deep coverage on pricing.html including top, mid, and lower sections.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all major visible controls on pricing.html: representative matrix cells across the grid, the calculation disclosure, most or all 9 add-on checkboxes, tier explainer linkage, FAQ interactions if available, and key header/footer links.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat the critical entry path and a focused subset of pricing interactions on mobile, emphasizing nav tap targets, matrix usability, add-on toggles, sticky quote behavior, and long-page scrolling.

notes: Allocate most of the step budget to pricing.html because nearly all interactive complexity is concentrated there.
Do not assume external pages exist behind '#' links; record their observed behavior instead.
Prioritize state transitions and synchronization issues over exhaustive reading of every static text block.

prescan_summary.title: Lattice DB — Analytics database
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: Lattice DB Platform Pricing Docs Customers Sign in Book demo The relational column-store for teams that want both axes priced honestly. Lattice DB combines a Postgres-compatible API with a Parquet-backed analytical engine. Mix transactional and analytical workloads without a separate warehouse. SELECT region, sum(revenue) AS r FROM orders JOIN customers USING (customer_id) WHERE order_date >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY region ORDER BY r DESC; Postgres wire Drop in any pg client. We speak the protocol. Columnar under the hood Vectorized execution. Late materialization. Zone maps. Pay for the cell you live in Pricing on team size × data size. No phantom add-ons. See pricing Local demo for UXBench. Fictional product, not a real company.
headings: The relational column-store for teams that want both axes priced honestly.
Pay for the cell you live in

Mobile usability is weakened by tiny checkbox controls: the Read replica checkbox and other add-on inputs are only 13x13px, and the page also has horizontal overflow (475px content width on a 390px viewport).
